title: Senior People Programs Manager
description:
About: Lattice & Loom builds performance and growth tooling for people teams at 400+ companies. We are a 280-person, remote-first team and we practice what we sell.

What you'll do:
- Own our end-to-end people programs portfolio: onboarding, career development, and manager enablement
- Design and run career-pathing frameworks with department leads
- Coach managers through performance and growth conversations
- Partner with recruiting on candidate-to-employee experience
- Measure program impact with engagement and retention data

What we're looking for: 6+ years across recruiting, coaching, or people programs; a track record of shipping programs that people actually use; strong facilitation chops; comfort operating autonomously in a distributed team. Experience as a career coach or talent advisor is a real plus here, not a nice-to-have.

This role is fully remote within the US. Base salary range is $135,000-$160,000 plus equity and a meaningful benefits package. We hire for judgment, not pedigree, and we move fast on strong candidates.

title: Senior Manager, Talent Development & Coaching
description:
About: Brightpath Health is a 350-person virtual-care company helping patients manage chronic conditions. Our people team is small and senior, and this role is its talent-development anchor.

What you'll do:
- Build our internal coaching practice from the ground up, including 1:1 coaching for emerging leaders
- Run quarterly talent reviews and succession planning with the executive team
- Create internal mobility pathways in partnership with recruiting
- Facilitate leadership workshops for our first-time managers
- Advise on hiring bar and interviewer training

What we're looking for: Someone with deep roots in recruiting and career coaching who has grown into program ownership. You have 7+ years in talent, hold or are pursuing a coaching credential (ICF or similar is great), and you can translate fuzzy people problems into structured programs. You write clearly and facilitate with warmth.

Compensation: $128,000-$150,000 base depending on experience, plus bonus and equity. Fully remote anywhere in the US; we gather twice a year for a company offsite.

title: Senior Onboarding Program Lead
description:
About: Fernwood Labs (42 people, remote-first) makes CI observability tools engineers actually enjoy. We are doubling headcount over the next 18 months and hiring our first dedicated onboarding lead.

What you'll do:
- Design and own new-hire onboarding end to end, from offer acceptance through day 90
- Build role-specific ramp plans with hiring managers
- Stand up a buddy and mentorship program
- Coach new managers on running great first-90-day experiences
- Partner tightly with our two recruiters on candidate experience and handoff
- Instrument the program: time-to-productivity, 90-day retention, new-hire NPS

What we're looking for: You have spent years close to hiring, either in recruiting or people programs, and you know what a great candidate-to-employee journey feels like. You are a builder who is comfortable being the whole function. Coaching experience is highly valued; you will spend real time with humans, not just docs.

Base salary $125,000-$145,000 plus early-stage equity. Fully remote in the US, with one optional team gathering per quarter.

title: People Programs Manager
description:
About: Copperline Commerce powers checkout and loyalty for 2,000 independent retailers. We are 220 people headquartered in Denver with a hybrid setup: three days a week in our RiNo office, two wherever you work best.

What you'll do:
- Run our core people programs calendar: engagement surveys, performance cycles, onboarding cohorts
- Redesign our manager onboarding track
- Own program communications so nothing lands as a surprise
- Partner with HRBPs and recruiting on program handoffs
- Keep our HRIS data clean enough to actually report on

What we're looking for: 5+ years in people programs, talent, or a related people-team role. You are organized to a fault, you write well, and you can facilitate a room of skeptical managers. Coaching or recruiting background welcome; this role touches both.

Compensation: $115,000-$135,000 base plus annual bonus. Hybrid in Denver is required; we are not able to support fully remote for this position. Great snacks, better mountains.

title: Learning & Development Manager
description:
About: Nova Terrace Software is a 1,400-person SaaS company serving the logistics industry. Our L&D team of four supports everything from new-hire training to leadership academies, and we are adding a manager to own our core curriculum.

What you'll do:
- Manage our LMS and quarterly training calendar
- Design and deliver manager fundamentals training, live and async
- Run needs analyses with department leaders and turn findings into learning roadmaps
- Manage external training vendors and coaching partners
- Report on completion, application, and learner feedback

What we're looking for: 4-6 years in L&D or an adjacent talent role. Strong facilitation skills across video and in-person formats. Experience with Articulate or similar authoring tools preferred. If you come from coaching or talent development rather than classic instructional design, we would still love to hear from you; several of our best people took that path.

This is a fully remote US-based role. Compensation is competitive and discussed early in the process, along with our benefits and professional development stipend (every L&D person deserves one).

title: Lead, Career Development Programs
description:
About: Harborview Analytics helps insurers price climate risk. We are 180 people, profitable, and serious about growing careers as fast as we grow revenue.

What you'll do:
- Own career development end to end: leveling frameworks, growth conversations, promotion processes
- Coach individual contributors and managers through career transitions
- Build a lightweight internal coaching program and train peer coaches
- Facilitate quarterly career workshops
- Partner with recruiting to align external leveling with internal frameworks

What we're looking for: You have coached people through real career decisions, and you have the program instincts to scale that beyond 1:1s. 6+ years in talent development, coaching, or recruiting with a development focus. You are analytical enough to defend a leveling decision with data and human enough to deliver hard feedback kindly.

Compensation: $120,000-$140,000 base plus bonus. This is a hybrid role: two days a week in our Seaport office, the rest remote. Occasional travel (a few trips a year) to our Chicago office.

title: Manager, Employee Experience & Onboarding
description:
About: Sundial Retail Group operates 900 stores and a Minneapolis headquarters of 2,000 corporate employees. Our Employee Experience team makes the corporate side of Sundial a place people brag about.

What you'll do:
- Run corporate onboarding for roughly 60 new hires a month, including a two-day welcome program
- Redesign our onboarding journey with our HR technology team
- Own new-hire surveys and turn results into quarterly improvements
- Coordinate with recruiting, IT, facilities, and hiring managers so day one just works
- Support culture programming and recognition initiatives

What we're looking for: 4+ years in onboarding, employee experience, recruiting coordination, or people programs. You sweat details, communicate proactively, and stay calm when a cohort of 70 shows up and the badges are wrong. Facilitation experience strongly preferred.

Salary range is $105,000-$125,000 plus a 10% target bonus and strong retail discounts. Hybrid: three days a week at our downtown Minneapolis HQ.

title: Leadership Development Partner
description:
About: Cobalt Ridge Systems protects critical infrastructure for utilities and transit agencies. We are 900 people distributed across the US, and our leadership bench has not kept pace with our growth. That is where you come in.

What you'll do:
- Design and run our director-and-above leadership development program
- Deliver 1:1 coaching engagements for high-potential leaders
- Administer and debrief 360s and psychometric assessments
- Facilitate quarterly leadership summits (virtual, with one in-person session annually)
- Build succession plans with the CPO and executive team

What we're looking for: A seasoned coach and program builder. 7+ years in leadership development, executive coaching, or senior talent roles. Certification in at least one assessment instrument preferred. You are credible in a room of VPs and unafraid to tell them what the data says.

This is a fully remote position with travel limited to roughly four events per year. Compensation is benchmarked to senior market rates and shared in the first conversation, along with details on bonus and equity.

title: Director of Learning & Organizational Development
description:
About: Meridian Care Alliance is a network of 30 outpatient clinics and 8,000 employees across the Southeast. We are investing heavily in developing clinical and administrative leaders, and this Director will own that agenda.

What you'll do:
- Set L&D and OD strategy for the enterprise and manage a team of six
- Own a seven-figure learning budget and vendor portfolio
- Partner with clinical education on compliance and licensure training
- Lead org design and change management for major operational initiatives
- Report quarterly to the executive committee on talent readiness

What we're looking for: 10+ years in L&D or OD with at least 4 years managing teams, ideally in healthcare or another regulated industry. You have run enterprise-scale programs, not just built them. Master's in OD, I/O psychology, or related field preferred.

Compensation: $155,000-$185,000 base plus executive bonus. This is a hybrid role based at our Nashville support center, four days a week on site, with monthly travel to clinic locations. Relocation assistance available.

title: L&D Program Specialist
description:
About: Peakwater Grocers runs 45 stores across the Mountain West from our Boise headquarters. Our Training team keeps 4,000 store and HQ employees compliant, confident, and growing.

What you'll do:
- Coordinate training logistics: scheduling, rooms, materials, LMS enrollments
- Deliver weekly new-hire orientation at HQ
- Maintain our LMS and troubleshoot learner issues
- Update training decks and job aids as programs evolve
- Track completion rates and flag gaps to the L&D Manager

What we're looking for: 1-3 years in training coordination, HR admin, or retail operations. You are organized, friendly, and dependable, and you like the energy of running a live session. Familiarity with any LMS is a plus; we will teach you ours.

This position is based full time at our Boise headquarters. Salary range is $62,000-$74,000 depending on experience, with a generous grocery discount, tuition reimbursement, and a clear path toward L&D Specialist and Program Manager roles. Come grow with us.

title: People Development Manager
description:
About: Argent Financial Partners is a regional bank with 6,500 employees and 190 branches across the Carolinas. Our People Development team ensures every banker is trained, licensed, and audit-ready.

What you'll do:
- Manage the compliance and regulatory training curriculum across retail banking
- Build and update courses in Cornerstone with our instructional designers
- Facilitate in-person training academies at our Charlotte campus
- Partner with Risk and Legal to keep content current with regulation changes
- Prepare training records for internal and external audits

What we're looking for: 4+ years in L&D within banking, insurance, or another regulated environment. Working knowledge of banking regulations (BSA/AML exposure a plus). You are precise, process-driven, and comfortable presenting to auditors as well as new tellers.

This is a fully on-site position at our Charlotte headquarters; our training academies are hands-on and in person by design. Compensation is discussed during the interview process and includes a comprehensive banking benefits package and pension plan.

title: Corporate Trainer & Development Coach
description:
About: Velocity Sales Institute delivers sales-skills bootcamps and coaching to SMB sales teams nationwide. We are a lean 30-person operation of trainers who eat what they kill.

What you'll do:
- Deliver our flagship two-day virtual sales bootcamp to client teams
- Coach client sales reps in follow-up sessions
- Prospect and close your own client roster; every trainer here is also a seller
- Customize workshop content to client industries
- Manage your pipeline in HubSpot

What we're looking for: A confident facilitator with sales or coaching experience who wants unlimited earning potential and full ownership of their book of business. Self-starters only; there is no base salary safety net and no cap either.

Compensation: This role is 100% commission-based. You earn 40% of every training contract you close and deliver, plus 15% residuals on renewals. Top trainers cleared $200k last year; new trainers should expect a 4-6 month ramp with no guaranteed income. Remote within the US. If commission-only compensation is not for you, this is not your role, and that is okay.

title: Field Training & Enablement Manager
description:
About: Orchard Gate Hospitality operates 120 restaurants and hotels across 22 states. Our field training team is the engine behind every new location opening and every brand-standards rollout.

What you'll do:
- Lead on-site training for new location openings, typically 2-3 weeks per opening
- Deliver train-the-trainer certification to general managers in the field
- Roll out new menu, service, and systems training property by property
- Audit training quality during site visits and coach local trainers
- Report field readiness to regional VPs

What we're looking for: 5+ years in field training, restaurant or hotel operations, or multi-unit L&D. You thrive on the road and love the buzz of an opening week. Spanish proficiency is a plus.

Important: Expect 100% travel. You will be on site at properties across the country essentially every week, home most weekends. A company travel card, per diem, and airline status support come standard. Salary range is $95,000-$115,000 plus an annual opening bonus. Home base can be anywhere near a major Texas airport; Dallas preferred.
